name: PIN / Biometric Pad
hint: Type a wrong code to see the dots shake, then the demo code 2580 to unlock. Or tap the Face ID button.
description: Passcode and Face ID lock screen for React Native, shown as a finance app locked over generative wallpaper. Glass keypad keys with phone letters light up on press-in and ease back on release, with a tap haptic per key, and each entered dot fills with a small pop. A wrong code sets the dot row wobbling on a released spring that decays like a real shake while the dots flash red and the title reads Wrong passcode; the right code lights the dots in sequence, folds them into a check, swings the app icon's shackle open and lifts the lock screen away to the unlocked app. The Face ID button plays a scan with closing corner brackets, a sweeping ring and a face that looks side to side, and can be set to fail once and fall back to the keypad. 4 or 6 digits, digits and Backspace on a hardware keyboard, screen-reader labels and live progress.
intents: passcode lock screen with face id
pin entry keypad with shake on wrong code
react native app lock pin pad
biometric unlock screen for a banking app
usage: Use to re-lock an app that holds private data (money, health, a journal) after it has been in the background. Offer biometrics first where the device has them, keep the passcode as the fallback, and always give a recovery path. Never show the real code: the demo hint is for the gallery only.
